# Sorry, Claude.
### **3. Claude Fable-5.1:** _where_ **&** _how_ **?**
[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!iP96!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F4c2e246f-04a5-4ce5-849b-5063f9acfafa_3456x1210.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!iP96!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F4c2e246f-04a5-4ce5-849b-5063f9acfafa_3456x1210.png) Click on the **model selector**, and pick **Fable-5.1**.

[![](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!n2vh!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fbda1133b-0857-48a3-a02c-a647faf2088d_3456x1918.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!n2vh!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fbda1133b-0857-48a3-a02c-a647faf2088d_3456x1918.png) Access it here: **[prompting-claude-fable-5-1](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-fable-5-1)**.

#### #1. Ask for more.
```
Before you start, say in a line what you're about to do; brief updates while you work help the user follow along. Close with a short recap that stands on its own — what you found, what you did, and what's next — so a reader who only sees the last message has the full picture.
```

### Anthropic claims 75% cheaper cache reads, a near-doubling in business-workflow performance, and stronger computer use. Here is what I will be testing before I trust it with my businesses or my writing.
